description: This PHP class 'SystemConfiguration' manages system configuration data for the OrangeHRM application, including retrieving organization info, admin details, and handling registration events, with database interactions and configuration management.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: A class for managing system configuration, including retrieving organization info, admin details, and handling registration events in the database.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for database schema operations.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Fetches the organization name from the database or returns 'Not Captured' if unavailable.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Fetches the organization country from the database or returns 'Not Captured' if unavailable.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language setting from configuration or defaults to 'en_US'.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Fetches the admin employee's first name from the database or defaults to 'Admin'.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Fetches the admin employee's last name from the database.

methods.name: getAdminEmail
methods.description: Fetches the admin employee's email from the database or returns 'Not Captured'.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Fetches the admin employee's contact number or returns 'Not Captured'.

methods.name: getAdminUserName
methods.description: Fetches the admin user's username from the database.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the system instance identifier from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the admin employee number from the database.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates and sets a new system instance identifier based on provided info.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded string as the system instance identifier from given parameters.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the registration event queue table exists in the database.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Inserts a registration event record into the database, with optional data and event time.
